summary: Enable shared engineering skills and review agents in Claude Code, with rules that load relevant guidance for testing, debugging, errors and writing.
description: Enable the Claude Essentials plugin and route relevant project files to its engineering and writing skills. Short path-scoped rules cover testing, errors, debugging and documentation, while AGENTS.md remains the source for project facts. The plugin takes effect in a trusted Claude Code session. It supplies guidance and review agents; it does not enforce checks or change other coding assistants.
seoDescription: Enable Claude Essentials for a project, with path-scoped rules that load engineering, testing, debugging and writing guidance in Claude Code.

projectExamples.title: Documented API contribution workflow
projectExamples.description: Use the plugin's testing and error-handling guidance while extending an Effect API. Project-specific conventions still belong in the repository's own instructions.

projectExamples.title: Blog editing guidance
projectExamples.description: Load writing guidance when Claude edits blog documentation and testing guidance when it changes components. Authors still review the resulting copy and code.
